title: Gps
description: Where the head is on Earth, up to 1 Hz (CoreLocation: GNSS where the device has it, otherwise Wi-Fi). Sent only after the user allows location access; the first subscription asks. WGS 84. Every payload field is present unless the subscription named `fields`; `alt_m`, `v_accuracy_m`, `speed_m_s` and `course_deg` are left out when unknown.

alt_m.description: Altitude above mean sea level in metres.

h_accuracy_m.description: Radius of horizontal uncertainty in metres (68 %).

course_deg.description: Direction of travel, degrees clockwise from true north.

sensor_time_s.description: When the fix was taken, seconds since device boot (the clock of `imu`).

payload.description: Complete payload, as sent when the subscription names no `fields`.
